# The Fedora packages CI installs to configure, build and test PlasmaZones
# against Fedora's Qt, KDE Frameworks and KWin. One package per line. A comment
# after `#` is ignored. The build dependencies are the ones of
# packaging/rpm/plasmazones.spec.
gcc-c++
git
ccache
cmake
ninja-build
extra-cmake-modules
qt6-qtbase-devel
qt6-qtbase-private-devel
qt6-qtdeclarative-devel
qt6-qtshadertools-devel
qt6-qtsvg-devel
qt6-qttools-devel
qt6-qtwayland-devel
wayland-devel
wayland-protocols-devel
plasma-wayland-protocols-devel
vulkan-headers
vulkan-loader-devel
libepoxy-devel
libdrm-devel
libxkbcommon-devel
kf6-kcmutils-devel
kf6-kconfig-devel
kf6-kcolorscheme-devel
kf6-kcoreaddons-devel
kf6-kglobalaccel-devel
kf6-kirigami-devel
kf6-kwindowsystem-devel
kwin-devel
plasma-activities-devel
systemd-devel
systemd-rpm-macros
# dbus-run-session, which PhosphorTestIsolation runs each test under.
dbus-daemon
# Test-time tools: xvfb and Mesa (llvmpipe) for the tests that need a display
# or a real GL context, cava and ffmpeg for phosphor-audio.
xorg-x11-server-Xvfb
mesa-dri-drivers
mesa-libEGL
cava
ffmpeg-free
